proof_body:
by
  intro f c r ε hr hf hs v hv
  by_contra hno
  have hcl : closure (Metric.ball c r) = Metric.closedBall c r := closure_ball c hr.ne'
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, f z - v ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    exact hno ⟨z, hz, sub_eq_zero.mp h⟩
  have hinv : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => (f z - v)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c r) := by
    refine ⟨(hf.differentiableOn.sub_const v).inv (fun z hz => hne z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz)), ?_⟩
    rw [hcl]
    have hc : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c r) := by
      rw [← hcl]; exact hf.continuousOn
    exact (hc.sub continuousOn_const).inv₀ hne
  have hdist : ‖f c - v‖ < ε / 2 := by
    have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hv
    rwa [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at this
  have hε : 0 < ε / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) hdist
  have hbd := Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le (U := Metric.ball c r) (z := c) Metric.isBounded_ball hinv (C := (ε / 2)⁻¹) (by
    intro z hz
    rw [frontier_ball c hr.ne'] at hz
    simp only [norm_inv]
    apply inv_anti₀ hε
    have h1 := hs z hz
    have h2 : ‖f z - f c‖ ≤ ‖f z - v‖ + ‖f c - v‖ := by
      have e : f z - f c = (f z - v) - (f c - v) := by ring
      rw [e]
      exact norm_sub_le _ _
    linarith) (subset_closure (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
  rw [norm_inv] at hbd
  have hp : 0 < ‖f c - v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne c (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le))
  have := (inv_le_inv₀ hp hε).mp hbd
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r ε : ℝ), 0 < r → DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c r) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c r, ε ≤ ‖f z - f c‖) → Metric.ball (f c) (ε / 2) ⊆ f '' Metric.closedBall c r
